records.speaker: Candace Owens

verification.notes: Rechecked under the statement verification rules. Hillsdale College identifies Jon Lewis as a veteran Marine Sergeant, and reporting describing his intelligence role places it in the U.S. Marine Corps. That contradicts the claim that he was a naval intelligence officer: the documented rank was enlisted Sergeant and the branch was the Marine Corps, not the Navy. His religion degree does not establish that he became a pastor, and no reliable source found supports that part. The legacy false determination is preserved in provenance; this current result adds direct supporting sources.

records.text: Owens said, as her perspective, that Miriam Adelson gave Trump 100 million dollars with the explicit understanding he would allow Israel to annex the West Bank
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Miriam Adelson gave him $100 million, and she was explicit. The $100 million meant that he would allow them to annex—not Gaza—the West Bank. So all this chatter of "Oh, that would be a step too far—no, blah, blah, blah." He pre-agreed to that, and he's gonna make good on his pre-agreement. That's my perspective.

verification.notes: The donation amount is supported: the FEC filing records Miriam Adelson’s aggregate 2024 contribution to Preserve America PAC at $106 million. Annexation was publicly reported as a policy she supported, but her spokesperson denied that her backing was offered in exchange for Trump publicly supporting West Bank annexation. The record therefore supports the donation and the policy interest but not an undisputed explicit quid pro quo. The legacy note’s corrupted amount is preserved only as provenance; this current note corrects it from the FEC filing.
